title: Can statistical roles be discovered independently of total strength?
question: Do relative stats (stat / BST) on fully evolved Pokémon form real, stable groups?
methodology: Fully evolved (568) on relative stats; compare silhouette to a shuffled-column baseline (10 shuffles, 95th percentile) and measure bootstrap stability (20 resamples, ARI).
interpretation: Every k=3-8 beats the shuffled baseline, but by at most 0.037. No k>=3 is stable (best ARI 0.591). Role structure exists but is weak: Pokémon stat shapes look like a continuum, not discrete groups.
limitations: Silhouette and K-Means both assume round, similar-sized groups; overlapping groups would score poorly.
